description: How the user adds money to the balance: stablecoins (USDC, USDT or USDG, on the networks that are on) sent to their own deposit address — one address for every EVM network, another on Solana — credited 1 coin = $1, plus the top-up page link. Use it when an order fails with insufficient_balance. Tell the user to send only the listed coin on the listed network. You cannot move money yourself — give the user the address or the link.
name: get_top_up_info
title: How to top up
